created: Created. Give people access under <grants>Access › Grants</grants>.
unprotectBody: Deleting it, and a retention that expires its tables, become possible.
propertiesNote: Properties are set when an environment is created through the REST API (properties of POST /api/v1/environments); they cannot be changed afterwards.
incomplete: Some sizes are not measured yet; the worker measures them in its next sweeps.
storageIntro: Where the tables' files are and which secret opens them. The root cannot be changed.
storageProtected: The storage of a protected environment cannot be changed. Unprotect it first.
deleteIntro: Deleting it drops its tables and revokes what is granted on it. It can be restored for the undo period unless its files are deleted too.
deleteProtected: Protected environments cannot be deleted. Unprotect it first.
storageNeedsSecrets: Changing the storage of an environment with a storage secret needs the right to manage secrets in {{name}}: an option such as s3.endpoint decides where the secret is sent.

runAs.title: Deployments
runAs.intro: Each repository deployed here, its commit, and who its runs write as. Once an account is bound, every run of the deployment writes as it, scheduled or started by a person, in a protected environment or not.
runAs.unboundProtected: No account: runs are refused until one is bound
runAs.unbound: No account: runs started by a person write as that person; schedules do not run
runAs.dialogTitle: Set the run-as account of {{repository}} in {{name}}
runAs.principalHelp: An active service account. Every run of this deployment writes with its rights: grant it what the project's assets need, and nothing else.
runAs.nothingChanged: It already runs as this account.
runAs.bound: Runs of {{repository}} in {{name}} now write as {{principal}}.
runAs.clearTitle: Clear the run-as account of {{repository}} in {{name}}?
runAs.clearProtected: {{name}} is protected: runs of {{repository}} are refused until an account is bound again.
runAs.clearUnprotected: Runs of {{repository}} that a person starts then write as that person, and its schedules stop running.
runAs.cleared: Runs of {{repository}} in {{name}} write as no account now.
